spec.title: The seven tests moved to the proof tier on 2026-11-17, run as proof tier
spec.description: Seven Rust tests left the default run for the proof tier, by the user's decision on 2026-11-17 to retier what is over the tool tier's limits or runs JBMC or TLC: observations.rs's Box Office examples comparison, application_core_joint.rs's J1 quote family, application_core.rs's E1 and E2, and integration.rs's own-checker-against-JBMC agreement and its two TLC tests. Each passed in the default run earlier the same day; this runs them as the proof tier does (release, --ignored, by exact name), to show they pass there and what they take.
